payload.text: Luis was on time and explained everything before he touched the furnace. No surprises on the bill.

payload.author: Ben A.
payload.text: Booked a tune-up on Saturday morning and they actually showed up in the window. Furnace runs quieter now.

expect.detail: Showed up on time for a Saturday tune-up

payload.author: Keisha Brown
payload.text: Second year on the maintenance plan. They remind me every fall so I never have to think about it.

expect.detail: The fall reminder on the maintenance plan

payload.text: Good work on the AC, but it took three calls to get someone out here.
